text:
Adding another 2-year visa success story!
Rehovot branch, second A5 renewal, married. 

We did our interviews and she was filling out the change of status form. My husband noticed she wrote 12 months, and asked if two years was possible. She said she wasn't sure if it applied to us and went to go check/ask someone...and came back and said yes!

So, definitely ask the clerk. 

Thank you again to AIC for advocating for and publicizing this change - you saved us a year of renewal fees and lots of time and energy!

Also, unrelated to the visa length but maybe helpful for others: our interview was about half the usual holidays/bills questions as we expected, but the other half was basically going over all our entries and exits. Maybe it was just because I traveled alone once and my husband traveled alone twice this year, but we were a bit surprised.
